arxiv-2006-04985.title: Medidas de distanciamento social e mobilidade na América do Sul durante a pandemia por COVID-19: Condições necessárias e suficientes?
arxiv-2006-04985.creator: Gisliany Lillian Alves de Oliveira \orcidG, Luciana Conceição de Lima \orcidL, Ivanovitch Silva \orcidI, Marcel da Câmara Ribeiro-Dantas \orcidM, Kayo Henrique Monteiro \orcidK, Patricia Takako Endo \orcidP
arxiv-2006-04985.description: Abstract Em um cenário de inexistência de vacina para a COVID-19, intervenções não farmacêuticas são necessárias para conter o espraiamento do vírus e o colapso do sistema de saúde nas regiões afetadas. Uma dessas medidas é o distanciamento social, que objetiva reduzir as interações na comunidade por meio de fechamentos de estabelecimentos públicos e privados que envolvam aglomerações de pessoas.

arxiv-2108-03482.title: Hadron spectroscopy using the light-front holographic Schrödinger equation and the ’t Hooft equation
arxiv-2108-03482.creator: Mohammad Ahmady, Satvir Kaur, Sugee Lee MacKay, Chandan Mondal, Ruben Sandapen
arxiv-2108-03482.description: Abstract Light-front holographic QCD provides a successful first approximation to hadron spectroscopy in the chiral limit of ( 3 + 1 ) (3+1) -dim light-front QCD, where a holographic Schrödinger-like equation, with an emerging confining scale, κ \kappa , governs confinement in the transverse direction.

arxiv-2305-13358.title: Mapping Dark Matter in the Milky Way using Normalizing Flows and Gaia DR3
arxiv-2305-13358.creator: Sung Hak Lim, Eric Putney, Matthew R. Buckley, David Shih
arxiv-2305-13358.description: Abstract We present a novel, data-driven analysis of Galactic dynamics, using unsupervised machine learning – in the form of density estimation with normalizing flows – to learn the underlying phase space distribution of 6 million nearby stars from the Gaia DR3 catalog.

arxiv-2311-14547.title: Smooth and Gevrey Microlocal Hypoellipticity for a Class of Hypocomplex Tube Structures
arxiv-2311-14547.creator: Nicholas Braun Rodrigues
arxiv-2311-14547.description: Abstract . We prove a smooth and Gevrey- s s microlocal hypoellipticity result for a system of complex vector fields associated with a real-analytic locally integrable structure of tube type, that is also microlocal hypocomplex. In order to so, we employ the use of a certain partial F.B.I. transform adapted to the locally integrable structure, first introduced by M. S.

arxiv-2402-04097.title: Analysis of Deep Image Prior and Exploiting Self-Guidance for Image Reconstruction
arxiv-2402-04097.creator: Shijun Liang, Student Member, IEEE, Evan Bell, Qing Qu, Member, IEEE, Rongrong Wang, Saiprasad Ravishankar, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2402-04097.description: Abstract The ability of deep image prior (DIP) to recover high-quality images from incomplete or corrupted measurements has made it popular in inverse problems in image restoration and medical imaging including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, conventional DIP suffers from severe overfitting and spectral bias effects.

arxiv-2403-10174.title: Topology optimization of blazed gratings under conical incidence
arxiv-2403-10174.creator: Simon Ans, Frédéric Zamkotsian, Guillaume Demésy
arxiv-2403-10174.description: Abstract A topology optimization method is presented and applied to a blazed diffraction grating in reflection under conical incidence. This type of grating is meant to disperse the incident light on one particular diffraction order and this property is fundamental in spectroscopy.

arxiv-2407-08629.title: A lattice framework for generalizing shellable complexes and matroids
arxiv-2407-08629.creator: Rakhi Pratihar 1, Tovohery H. Randrianarisoa 2 and Klara Stokes 2
arxiv-2407-08629.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rakhi Pratihar 1, Tovohery H. Randrianarisoa 2 and Klara Stokes 2. We introduce the notion of power lattices that unifies and extends the equicardinal geometric lattices, Cartesian products of subspace lattices, and multiset subset lattices, among several others. The notions of shellability for simplicial complexes, q q -complexes, and multicomplexes are then unified and extended to that of complexes in power lattices, which we name as 𝒫 \mathcal{P} -complexes .

arxiv-2410-15476.title: NONLINEARITY, FRACTALS, FOURIER DECAY Harmonic analysis of equilibrium states for hyperbolic dynamical systems
arxiv-2410-15476.creator: Gaétan Leclerc
arxiv-2410-15476.description: Abstract This PhD lies at the intersection between fractal geometry and hyperbolic dynamics. Being given a (low dimensional) hyperbolic dynamical system f f in some euclidean space, let us consider a fractal compact invariant subset K K , and an invariant probability measure μ \mu supported on K K with good statistical properties, such as the measure of maximal entropy.

arxiv-2505-21630.title: Quasar absorption outflows on galactic scales: Insights from DESI 2026 Quasar absorption outflows on galactic scales: Insights from DESI – References
arxiv-2505-21630.creator: Maryam. Dehghanian, Nahum. Arav, Mayank Sharma, Gwen Walker, Kyle. Johnston, Matthew. Kaupin, Justin. Gandhi
arxiv-2505-21630.description: Abstract Absorption outflows in quasars play an important role in understanding active galactic nuclei (AGN) feedback and their influence on galaxy evolution. The unprecedented spectral data provided by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) opens new avenues to explore these outflows.

arxiv-2512-23108.title: Vietoris thickenings and complexes of manifolds are homotopy equivalent
arxiv-2512-23108.creator: Henry Adams, Alexandre Karassev, Žiga Virk
arxiv-2512-23108.description: Abstract . We show that if X X is a finite-dimensional Polish metric space, then the natural bijection VR ⁡ ( X , r ) → VR m ​ ( X , r ) \mathrm{VR}(X;r)\to\mathrm{VR}^{\mathrm{m}}(X;r) from the (open) Vietoris–Rips complex to the Vietoris–Rips metric thickening is a homotopy equivalence. This occurs, for example, if X X is a Riemannian manifold.

britannica-1911-medici-giacomo.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-medici-giacomo.description: Article 'Medici, Giacomo' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born at Milan in January 1817. pmc-10718378.title: Atypical presentation of hyperthyroidism complicated complete hydatidiform mole in a 24-year-old female: a case report
pmc-10718378.creator: Marah Mansour, Rania Almasri, Noura Amin, George Hamwi, Rawdah Attoum, Ilda Moafak Kanbour, Sara Mohammad Talal Jeniat, Samar AlKhrait
pmc-10718378.description: Introduction and importance:Molar pregnancy is the most common type of gestational trophoblastic disease. It manifests as vaginal bleeding, accompanied by high levels of β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG). This case aims to highlight the importance of considering gestational trophoblastic disease as a potential diagnosis and its serious complications.Case presentation:A 24-year-old female presented with vomiting, nausea, and no complaint of vaginal bleeding.

pmc-10741435.title: Susceptibility Genes Associated with Multiple Primary Cancers
pmc-10741435.creator: Mengyao Lu, Xuemei Zhang, Qian Chu, Yuan Chen, Peng Zhang
pmc-10741435.description: Simple SummaryWith advanced cancer treatments and screening techniques, a growing number of cancer survivors face the challenge of multiple primary cancers (MPCs), affecting approximately one in six patients. Distinguishing MPCs from recurrences or metastases is still challenging due to the limited clinicopathological criteria available. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) has facilitated the comprehension of MPCs from a genetic standpoint.

pmc-11285309.title: SGLT-2 inhibitors in chronic peritoneal dialysis patients: a follow-up study
pmc-11285309.creator: Jia-Wen Lai, Charles CN Wang, Che-Yi Chou
pmc-11285309.description: BackgroundSodium-glucose transporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT-2i) are recommended for use in patients with type 2 diabetes comorbid atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, heart failure, or chronic kidney disease. Limited reports are currently available for their use in dialysis patients. In an observational, retrospective follow-up study, we reported the clinical characteristics of chronic peritoneal dialysis (PD) patients on SGLT-2i.

pmc-11339587.title: Longitudinal Coadaptation of Older Adults With Wearables and Voice-Activated Virtual Assistants: Scoping Review
pmc-11339587.creator: Kristina Marie Kokorelias, Alisa Grigorovich, Maurita T Harris, Umair Rehman, Louise Ritchie, AnneMarie M Levy, Kerstin Denecke, Josephine McMurray
pmc-11339587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe integration of smart technologies, including wearables and voice-activated devices, is increasingly recognized for enhancing the independence and well-being of older adults. However, the long-term dynamics of their use and the coadaptation process with older adults remain poorly understood.

pmc-12626965.title: Esketamine for postoperative sleep disturbance: clinical evidence, mechanisms, and future directions
pmc-12626965.creator: Qijing Liu, Ying Liu, Qian Fu, Boxiong Gao, Yatao Liu
pmc-12626965.description: Postoperative sleep disturbance (PSD) is a common complication following surgery. Numerous factors can contribute to PSD, including personal factors, intraoperative factors, postoperative complications and environmental factors. PSD can lead to a range of adverse outcomes, severely impairing patients’ postoperative recovery and long-term prognosis.

pmc-13458237.title: HAMNet: Hierarchical Multi-scale Attention Network for precise disease detection in pearl millet using spatial fusion
pmc-13458237.creator: S. Ramya, D. Pradeep
pmc-13458237.description: Pearl millet is a vital crop in arid and semi-arid regions, but its productivity is significantly impacted by fungal and bacterial diseases. Traditional disease detection methods, including manual inspection and conventional machine learning techniques, often suffer from inefficiencies due to subjectivity, time consumption, and limited feature extraction capabilities.
